commands.name: info
commands.description: Describe this client and its implemented capabilities; this is not a live domain health check.

commands.name: source status
commands.description: Inspect local source changes and publication state without changing a checkout or contacting an owner.

commands.name: source fetch
commands.description: Fetch explicitly selected remote source history without advancing the working branch or activating it.

commands.name: source fast-forward
commands.description: Advance the selected source branch only when a checked fast-forward preserves local work; do not merge, reset or activate it implicitly.

commands.name: source worktree
commands.description: Prepare a separate local worktree for a source proposal while preserving existing branches, worktrees and unpublished changes.

commands.name: source publish
commands.description: Ask the authorized source publisher to publish an exact proposal; host and application activation remains separate.

commands.name: source recover
commands.description: Recover source into fresh staging from the selected recovery material; this does not restore application data, enroll owners or activate services.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run only the explicitly trusted selected test suite and report its actual execution class and missing prerequisites.

commands.name: workspace open
commands.description: Register a local working context for selected domain source; registration grants no remote permission.

commands.name: workspace check
commands.description: Inspect local work, unresolved requests and preservation obligations without deleting or closing them.

commands.name: workspace export
commands.description: Explicitly export private working evidence and custody references; exported observations are not new owner authority.

commands.name: workspace close
commands.description: Check that local work and unresolved remote requests remain accounted for; closing does not delete files or cancel accepted owner work.

commands.name: receipts export
commands.description: Export selected private evidence for later inspection or transfer; no execution or authority is granted.

commands.name: receipts import
commands.description: Import evidence as untrusted reported material until its independent owner identity and provenance are verified.

commands.name: workflow resume
commands.description: Continue the exact recorded workflow after current owner authorization and reconciliation. A paused local capsule requires an owner-native NativeLifecycleDecision to resume under its current driver and exact generation; incomplete transfer, recovery-required and terminal states cannot be bypassed. Restoring client context alone does not change owner admission or silently create replacement work.

commands.name: tracking record
commands.description: Separately record best-effort metadata after execution; reporting failure never changes owner acceptance or execution outcomes.

commands.name: tracking check
commands.description: Diagnose the optional reporting integration without making it a prerequisite for management or recovery.

commands.name: tracking show
commands.description: Show reported history with its provenance; a report is not a fresh authoritative owner observation.

commands.name: host resources
commands.description: Observe the selected host capacity and reservations through its authorized owner; a quota maximum is not a physical reservation.

commands.name: app resources
commands.description: Observe the selected application resource use and protection through its authorized owner.

commands.name: app cleanup
commands.description: Prepare and apply only an exact owner-authorized cleanup plan for eligible material while retaining protected data and recovery references.

description: Proposed administrator-facing workflows. Domain context selects known hosts, applications and source; it is not a central authority. These declarations do not claim that the scaffold implements native operations.
